statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
These symptoms are poorly correlated with standard 24-hour Holter monitoring results
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a history of cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated
The denial reason code is CO-97
